faqs.a:
The authority may rent or lease to a tenant dwelling accommodations consisting of
               the number of rooms, but no greater number than that which it deems necessary, to
               provide safe and sanitary accommodations to the proposed occupants thereof without
               overcrowding.
(Code 1981, § 14-20; Ord. No. 1248, § 8(1)(c), 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-210(1)(c).
